segments.text: Ok so this is the Agent Read-Only Context page for Google Antigravity with Angular, and I'm reporting a problem on this page.
So this is the problem, this connect agent context call should send the user's name and timezone to the agent.
This is my project, I've implemented the exact code from the doc.
Moving on to the demo. I asked the agent who I am and which record is selected, but it doesn't know any of the values the app sent.
So basically, the context from the page never reaches the Antigravity agent.
So the agent can't use it at all.
So yeah, this is the issue, kindly fix it.
